ask: park whatever is at the gate
why: THE RIGHT ANSWER IS TO ASK. A verdict is recorded against a person's name, the kernel refuses a blank one, and this ask does not contain a name — so the only honest next move is to ask whose verdict it is. The failure guarded against is invention: `by: "agent"`, `by: "unknown"`, `by: "Claude"` all satisfy the argument check and put a name nobody can be asked about on a permanent record. `asks` is observed rather than asserted (the library has no ask mechanism yet); the half that bites today is that nothing may be committed.
